user.title: Sign in to Fuse Energy
user.description: Enter the mobile number your Fuse account uses, in international format (for example +447700900123). Fuse will text you a verification code.

code.title: Enter your code
code.description: Enter the 6-digit code Fuse sent to {phone_number}.

identity.title: Confirm your identity
identity.description: Fuse needs a little more information before it will sign you in. {prompt}

premises.title: Choose a property
premises.description: Your Fuse account covers more than one property. Pick the one to add; you can run this again to add the others.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Fuse Energy again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Fuse session has expired. Continue to have a new verification code sent to {phone_number}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Fuse. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_phone: Fuse did not accept that number. Use international format, for example +447700900123.
error.invalid_code: That code was not accepted. It may have expired -- request a new one if it keeps failing.
error.invalid_identity: Fuse did not accept those details. Check they match what is on your Fuse account.
error.sms_not_sent: Fuse accepted the number but did not send a code. This is usually temporary -- wait a few minutes and try again. If it persists, check the Home Assistant log for the reason Fuse gave.
error.sms_too_soon: Fuse is limiting how often it will send a code and refused to send another one yet. Wait a few minutes without retrying, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This property is already set up.
abort.no_premises: Signed in successfully, but no properties were found on this Fuse account.
abort.unsupported_challenge: Fuse asked for a verification step this integration does not support yet.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different Fuse account than the one being re-authenticated.
abort.reauth_successful: Successfully signed back in to Fuse Energy.
